headline: Indianapolis keeps their drive alive
what_happened: T.Warren ran the ball up the middle for three yards, which gives Indianapolis a first down—a fresh set of four tries to move the ball.
who: T.Warren carried the ball while G.Karlaftis tried to stop him.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it helps Indianapolis keep their offense on the field. Their chance of winning increased by 2 percentage points.
pop_culture: Taylor Swift is watching from the family suite at Arrowhead, and the vintage Chiefs tank top she wore sold out online after the game.
